modules.name: bloom
modules.purpose: Makes bright areas glow softly into their surroundings for a dreamy look.
modules.notes: Plain slider mapping, already in controls.h. GUI order is size, threshold, strength (bloom.c:382-392). '%' format with hard max 100 > 10 keeps factor 1 (bauhaus.c:3327). Digits 2 come from dt_bauhaus_slider_from_params (imageop_gui.c:104-105). Supports blending (flags :90).

modules.name: grain
modules.purpose: Adds film-like grain texture to the photo.
modules.notes: coarseness is stored as ISO/213.2: raw min/max/default 0.0938/30.0188/7.5047 display as 20/6400/1600 ISO (factor 213.2, grain.c:44,540). controls.h already uses scale 1/213.2. The params field 'channel' (grain.c:64, default lightness) has no GUI widget. GUI order: coarseness, strength, mid-tones bias.

modules.name: vignetting
modules.purpose: Darkens (or lightens) and desaturates the edges of the frame to draw the eye to the center.

controls.label: width/height ratio
controls.visible_when: autoratio == false (widget made insensitive, not hidden; vignette.c:973)

custom_widgets.what: drag the vignette center, the inner and the feather ellipse directly on the image

modules.notes: Plain sliders cover everything; the on-canvas ellipse is a convenience. Field 'unbound' (params :72, default TRUE) has no widget. '%' on scale/falloff keeps factor 1 because max 200 > 10. Preset 'lomo' exists (vignette.c:996-1012). controls.h already maps brightness, scale, falloff_scale.

modules.name: soften
modules.purpose: Blends a blurred, brightened copy over the photo for a soft, glowing (Orton) look.
modules.notes: Plain slider mapping. 'amount' is labelled 'mix' via $DESCRIPTION (soften.c:49), so its action path is 'mix'.

modules.name: framing
modules.purpose: Adds a solid border (and optional thin frame line) around the photo, optionally to a target aspect ratio.

controls.label: aspect ratio
controls.visible_when: always shown; combobox shows 'custom...' when the value matches no preset (borders.c:818-850)

custom_widgets.what: RGB color button plus point picker to take the border color from the image
RGB color button plus point picker to take the frame line color from the image

modules.notes: name() is 'framing' (borders.c:304-307). Sliders 'border size', 'frame line size', 'frame line offset' call set_digits(4) then set_format('%'); because hard max <= 10 bauhaus sets factor 100 and digits 4-2 = 2 (bauhaus.c:3327-3331), so display = raw*100. Each of aspect, pos_h, pos_v has a preset combobox AND a slider writing the same field; the combobox entries are GUI-only presets, not a params enum. Default aspect is -1 (constant border) which lies outside the slider's 1..3 range. Field max_border_size (:104) has no widget. Colors are display RGB 0..1 with no alpha. No blending support (flags :334-337); changes canvas size (IOP_FLAGS_EXPAND_ROI_IN), so it should stay late in the pipe and single-instance in practice.

modules.name: watermark
modules.purpose: Stamps an SVG/PNG logo or text signature onto the photo.

custom_widgets.what: combobox listing SVG/PNG files found in <datadir>/watermarks and <configdir>/watermarks, plus a refresh button
free text with $(VARIABLE) completion, inserted as $(WATERMARK_TEXT) into the SVG
GTK font button; sets $(WATERMARK_FONT_*) tags
RGB color button plus point picker; sets $(WATERMARK_COLOR)
nine toggle buttons choosing the anchor corner/edge/center

modules.notes: alignment index is row-major 0..8 over the 3x3 grid (gui: col i%3, row i/3, watermark.c:1520); labels in 'values' are descriptive, darktable shows icons only. The alignment buttons and the marker combobox define no module actions. text/color/font widgets are also persisted to darktablerc and the GUI initialises them from there (watermark.c:1428,1436,1450-1452), not from params defaults. rotation shows with factor -1 (displayed = -raw). Opacity '%' keeps factor 1 (max 100 > 10). Needs file-system access to the watermark directories; a text/font/color UI is required for useful use.

modules.name: composite
modules.purpose: Places another (processed) photo from the library on top of this one, e.g. for a logo or double exposure.

custom_widgets.what: 150x150 thumbnail area; the user drags an image from the filmstrip/lighttable onto it to choose the overlay
nine toggle buttons choosing the anchor

modules.notes: name() is 'composite' (overlay.c:145-148). The overlay source is another library image (imgid) rendered through its own history; Omalux would need an image picker from the library and must handle the referenced image being missing. Field labels for scale_* reuse the watermark wording ('marker'). Supports blending; description advises moving it after output color profile if banding appears (overlay.c:153-155).

modules.name: external raster masks
modules.purpose: Loads a mask image (PFM/PNG) made elsewhere so other modules can use it as a raster mask.

custom_widgets.what: folder button plus combobox of PFM/PNG files; path must be configured in preferences/processing first
'vectorize' converts the loaded bitmap into path shapes in the mask manager

modules.notes: Not an image effect by itself: it publishes a raster mask (IOP_FLAGS_WRITE_RASTER, rasterfile.c:117-120) that other modules pick in their blend section ('raster mask'). Belongs with a future blend/mask UI rather than a slider panel. Combobox values follow enum declaration order, not numeric order. No blending support itself.

modules.name: dither or posterize
modules.purpose: Adds fine noise to prevent banding in smooth gradients, or deliberately reduces the number of tones (posterize).
modules.notes: GUI order puts the damping slider above the method combobox (dither.c:737-742). Combobox order is enum declaration order, values are not contiguous (posterize = 0x101..0x107). Fields palette, random.radius, random.range are reserved and have no GUI. Default 'Floyd-Steinberg auto' matches the export bit depth.

modules.name: retouch
modules.purpose: Removes dust, blemishes and distractions by cloning, healing, blurring or filling painted areas, optionally per detail scale.

controls.label: mask opacity
controls.visible_when: a shape is selected (retouch.c:486-489); value lives in the mask form, not in params

custom_widgets.what: paint brush strokes / place circles, ellipses, paths on the image; for clone/heal also position the source
up to 300 shapes, each with its own algorithm, scale, blur/fill settings and opacity
drawing-area bar: top cursor = merge-from scale, bottom cursor = number of scales, click selects current scale
display masks, temporarily switch off shapes, cut/paste shapes between scales, display wavelet scale, auto levels
3-marker levels for previewing a single wavelet scale

modules.notes: Fundamentally an on-canvas painting module: without shape drawing nothing happens. The slider/combobox values edit the currently selected shape (or the defaults for new shapes); per-shape data lives in rt_forms[] and the mask manager. fill_brightness: set_digits(4) then '%' with max 1 -> factor 100, digits 2. mask opacity: range 0..1 digits 3 then '%' -> factor 100, digits 1. max_heal_iter (params :100) has no GUI. IOP_FLAGS_NO_MASKS: its blend section has no drawn/parametric/raster mask (flags :218-221).

modules.name: spot removal
modules.purpose: Old tool for cloning out sensor dust spots; replaced by retouch.

custom_widgets.what: place up to 64 clone shapes and their sources on the image

modules.notes: IOP_FLAGS_DEPRECATED (spots.c:77-80); deprecated_msg: 'please use the retouch module instead' (:57-60). Only keep for showing/removing it in legacy histories; do not offer for new edits.

modules.name: liquify
modules.purpose: Pushes, grows or shrinks parts of the image by dragging warp points, lines and curves.

custom_widgets.what: place warps; drag radius, strength vector and center/feather hardness handles; ctrl+click toggles linear/grow/shrink and node types

modules.notes: Has no sliders at all: radius, strength, hardness and warp type (linear / radial grow / radial shrink) are edited only on canvas. Requires a dedicated canvas tool in Omalux; no plain slider mapping possible.

modules.name: scale into final size
modules.purpose: Internal step that resizes the image to the output size.
modules.notes: IOP_FLAGS_HIDDEN | ONE_INSTANCE | NO_HISTORY_STACK (finalscale.c:40-45); params only 'dummy' (:28-31); no gui_init. Hidden pipeline-internal module: never show.

modules.name: display encoding
modules.purpose: Internal last step that converts the image to 8-bit display output and paints mask overlays.
modules.notes: IOP_FLAGS_HIDDEN | ONE_INSTANCE | FENCE (gamma.c:49-52); params gamma/linear unused by GUI; no gui_init. Hidden pipeline-internal module: never show.

modules.name: overexposed
modules.purpose: Darkroom clipping warning that marks crushed shadows and blown highlights on the preview.
modules.notes: IOP_FLAGS_HIDDEN | ONE_INSTANCE | NO_HISTORY_STACK (overexposed.c:76-79); no params (DT_MODULE(3), :30). Not a module panel: controlled from the darkroom toolbar button (shortcut o) and its right-click popover, settings stored in darktablerc darkroom/ui/overexposed/* and read in develop.c:146-149. Actions are view actions under the darkroom ('overexposed/...'), not module-relative. Omalux could expose it as a viewer clipping toggle, not as an edit control.

modules.name: raw overexposed
modules.purpose: Darkroom warning that marks pixels clipped already in the raw sensor data.

controls.label: color scheme
controls.visible_when: used only when mode == mark with solid color (tooltip, darkroom.c:3037)

modules.notes: IOP_FLAGS_HIDDEN | ONE_INSTANCE | NO_HISTORY_STACK (rawoverexposed.c:73-76); no params (DT_MODULE(1)). Driven from the darkroom toolbar (shift+o) and its popover; settings in darktablerc darkroom/ui/rawoverexposed/* (develop.c:138-142). A viewer overlay, not an edit.

modules.name: mask manager
modules.purpose: Internal holder for drawn mask shapes shared by all modules.
modules.notes: IOP_FLAGS_HIDDEN | ONE_INSTANCE | UNSAFE_COPY (mask_manager.c:50-53); params only 'dummy'; process() copies input to output. The user-facing mask manager is a lib panel (src/libs/masks.c), outside this inventory. Never show as a module.

modules.name: silly example
modules.purpose: Developer template module, not part of the build.
modules.notes: Not compiled: 'add_iop(useless "useless.c")' is commented out in src/iop/CMakeLists.txt:64. Template only (sliders 'size', 'factor', 'extra', combobox 'parameter choices', toggle 'checkbox option', useless.c:610-680). Ignore.

modules.name: blending (per-module blend section)
modules.purpose: Controls how strongly and where a module's result is applied: opacity, blend mode, and masks (drawn shapes, color/tone ranges, or masks from other modules).
tabs: parametric mask channel tabs (depend on blend colorspace): Lab: L, a, b, C, h; RGB (display): g, R, G, B, H, S, L; RGB (scene): g, R, G, B, Jz, Cz, hz

controls.label: blend mask mode
controls.visible_when: drawn & raster need !IOP_FLAGS_NO_MASKS; parametric needs blend colorspace Lab or RGB (blend_gui.c:3413-3414); whole row hidden if module hides enable button (:3329)

controls.label: fulcrum
controls.visible_when: blend colorspace == RGB (scene) and mode in {multiply, divide, addition, subtract, RGB red/green/blue channel, subtract/divide inverse} (:349-371, :3217)

controls.label: output
controls.visible_when: mask_mode has parametric; output row only when 'show output channels' is on or already used (:2499)

controls.label: boost factor
controls.visible_when: mask_mode has parametric; sensitive only on channels with boost_factor_enabled (:1239-1247)

controls.label: details threshold
controls.visible_when: mask_mode has drawn or parametric (or raster) AND image is raw (dt_image_is_rawprepare_supported, :3250)

controls.label: feathering guide
controls.visible_when: refine box shown: mask_mode has drawn/parametric/raster (:3252-3285)

controls.label: blend colorspace (blending options menu)
controls.default: module default (Lab / RGB display / RGB scene / RAW)
controls.visible_when: menu behind the presets icon in the mask-mode row; only when parametric masks are supported (:3488-3497)

custom_widgets.what: row of icon toggles: off, uniformly, drawn, parametric, drawn & parametric, raster; plus a 'blending options' menu
create/edit drawn shapes (brush, circle, ellipse, path, gradient, AI object) on the image; shapes live in the mask manager
per channel, input and output 4-marker range sliders (off/on/on/off) defining a parametric mask, with polarity toggles
'show color' picker shows picked values on the sliders; 'set range' picker sets the range from an image area (ctrl = output)
combobox populated with masks published by earlier modules (incl. external raster masks)
'display mask and/or color channel' and 'temporarily switch off blend mask' toggles (GUI state, not params)

modules.notes: Shown under every module with IOP_FLAGS_SUPPORTS_BLENDING (imageop.h:90). IOP_FLAGS_NO_MASKS (imageop.h:98, e.g. retouch, spots) leaves only off/uniformly. Parametric masks need blend colorspace Lab or RGB (blend_gui.c:3413). Params struct dt_develop_blend_params_t in blend.h:180-222; defaults in blend.c:41-66 (mask_mode off, blend_mode normal = 0x18, opacity 100, combine exclusive, feathering guide input after blur, all refinement 0, blendif ranges 0,0,1,1). blend_cst default comes from the module's blend_colorspace (blend.c:68-92), RGB scene vs display follows the workflow preference; for RGB scene, Jz/Cz boost factors default to -6.64385619 and the GUI adds that offset so it displays 0 (blend.c:94-113). Action paths are blend-relative as darktable defines them: sliders/comboboxes use section 'blend' (e.g. 'blend/opacity'), mode buttons 'blend`masks' -> 'blend/masks/<label>', tool toggles 'blend`tools', shapes 'blend`shapes', pickers 'blend`pickers'; in this file 'action' is written relative to the blend section where marked. Opacity: range 0..100 already in percent, factor 1, digits 0. details/mask opacity/mask contrast: range -1..1 shown as -100..100 % (factor 100, digits 0 after '%' adjustment, bauhaus.c:3327-3331). Note the label 'mask opacity' is the 'brightness' field. Parametric slider display scales per channel are in Lab_channels/rgb_channels/rgbj_channels (blend_gui.c:2340-2463), e.g. L 0..100, a/b -128..128, hue 0..360. A minimal Omalux 'blend' section could cover: mask_mode off/uniformly, blend mode, opacity, and the refinement sliders; drawn/parametric/raster masks need canvas drawing, range sliders and a module selector.
